summary: Since published versions can't be deleted or modified, install and review the collection locally before publishing to avoid extra versions.
questions: Can I delete a collection version after publishing it?
How should I check my collection before publishing?

answer_card.title: Check before publishing
answer_card.answer_md: Published versions **can't be deleted or changed**, so each publish needs a new version. Install the collection locally and review it first to avoid needless versions.
